Loads oncology case data from Brazil provided by DATASUS

Source: R/oncology_case.R
load_oncology_case.Rd

This function downloads and organizes data from the Oncology Panel (Painel de Oncologia), part of DATASUS, used in public health and epidemiological analyses.

Usage

load_oncology_case(time_period, raw_data = FALSE, language = "eng")

Arguments

time_period

A numeric value or vector indicating the year(s) of the data to be downloaded. For example, 2020 or 2015:2020.

raw_data

Logical. If TRUE, returns the raw data exactly as provided by DATASUS. If FALSE (default), returns a cleaned and standardized version of the dataset.

language

A string indicating the desired language of variable names and labels. Accepts "eng" (default) for English or "pt" for Portuguese.

Value

A data table containing oncology case records from the Oncology Panel of all Brazilian states for the specified period.

Connection Reliability

The DATASUS FTP server (ftp.datasus.gov.br) intermittently drops connections mid-transfer. Downloads are automatically retried up to 3 times.

Examples

if (FALSE) { # interactive()
# Download processed oncology data for the year 2023.
# This will return data from the Oncology Panel for all Brazilian states.
oncology_cases_treated <- load_oncology_case(time_period = 2023,
                                             raw_data = FALSE,
                                             language = "eng"
                                             )
}
